text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْغَٰشِيَةِ

translations.asad: HAS THERE COME unto thee the tiding of the Overshadowing Event?'
translations.sahih: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]?

translations.asad: Some faces will on that Day be downcast,
translations.sahih: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled,

translations.asad: toiling [under burdens of sin], worn out [by fear],
translations.sahih: Working [hard] and exhausted.

translations.asad: about to enter a glowing fire,
translations.sahih: They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire.

translations.asad: given to drink from a boiling spring.
translations.sahih: They will be given drink from a boiling spring.

text.arabic: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍۢ

translations.asad: No food for them save the bitterness of dry thorns,
translations.sahih: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant

text.arabic: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍۢ

translations.asad: which gives no strength and neither stills hunger.
translations.sahih: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger.

translations.asad: [And] some faces will on that Day shine with bliss,
translations.sahih: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure.

translations.asad: well-pleased with [the fruit of] their striving,
translations.sahih: With their effort [they are] satisfied

translations.asad: in a garden sublime,
translations.sahih: In an elevated garden,

translations.asad: wherein thou wilt hear no empty talk.
translations.sahih: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech.

translations.asad: Countless springs will flow therein,
translations.sahih: Within it is a flowing spring.

translations.asad: [and] there will be thrones [of happiness] raised high,
translations.sahih: Within it are couches raised high

translations.asad: and goblets placed ready,
translations.sahih: And cups put in place

translations.asad: and cushions ranged,
translations.sahih: And cushions lined up

translations.asad: and carpets spread out…
translations.sahih: And carpets spread around.

text.arabic: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ

translations.asad: DO, THEN, they [who deny resurrection] never gaze at the clouds pregnant with water, [and observe] how they are created?
translations.sahih: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?

translations.asad: And at the sky, how it is raised aloft?
translations.sahih: And at the sky - how it is raised?

translations.asad: And at the mountains, how firmly they are reared?
translations.sahih: And at the mountains - how they are erected?

translations.asad: And at the earth, how it is spread out?
translations.sahih: And at the earth - how it is spread out?

translations.asad: And so, [O Prophet,] exhort them; thy task is only to exhort:
translations.sahih: So remind, [O Muhammad]; you are only a reminder.

translations.asad: thou canst not compel them [to believe].
translations.sahih: You are not over them a controller.

translations.asad: However, as for him who turns away, being bent on denying the truth,
translations.sahih: However, he who turns away and disbelieves -

translations.asad: him will God cause to suffer the greatest suffering [in the life to come]:
translations.sahih: Then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment.

translations.asad: for behold, unto Us will be their return,
translations.sahih: Indeed, to Us is their return.

translations.asad: and verily, It is for Us to call them to account.
translations.sahih: Then indeed, upon Us is their account.
